purpose: Append raw-hit observations from the broader three-family scan without changing physical-evidence classes.

policy.rule: Every raw occurrence is retained for collision/source-frequency analysis but has zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: Only independently verified physical quantities can promote to P1/P2.
policy.no_hit: A defined search with no relevant exact occurrence is retained as a no-hit observation.
